name: c-assistant
description: Triage every Claude Code session you have open and report which ones are blocked on you - the question each one asked, what only you can do, and where two sessions are duplicating work. Includes /c-assistant-voice, a spoken variant for when your hands are busy. Designed to work best with SeaShell: with SeaShell 0.2.0+ it pushes live approval cards into the terminal when a session stops on a question.
